purpose: Review-only eye-level orthographic modeling-sheet candidates used to select canonical Player B body proportions before multi-view reconstruction.
camera: eye-level orthographic engineering views; exact front, exact right profile, exact back
facing: three equal-scale canonical body views in neutral A-pose
lighting: flat neutral studio illumination with no cast shadow or gameplay-camera foreshortening
prompt: Generate the approved Player B character as one fully opaque body-only modeling sheet with exact eye-level orthographic front, right-profile, and back views at identical scale. Correct the approved gameplay reference's 45-degree camera foreshortening, preserve the helmet, cyan visor, charcoal/navy armor, magenta identifiers, backpack, boots, and gloves, use an empty neutral A-pose, and include no weapon, text, grid, prop, transparency, or three-quarter view. Candidate A emphasizes hard-surface armor planes; B emphasizes compact tactical identity and 64-pixel readability; C emphasizes animation-ready joint clearance.
negative_constraints: no weapon, invisible grip, fused rifle, or horizontal weapon rotation
no gameplay 45-degree camera, bird's-eye view, perspective convergence, or three-quarter view
no translucent body, rounded melted clay geometry, squat chibi anatomy, or inconsistent armor
no production mesh, runtime atlas, or Player.gd integration before explicit selection

references.role: approved Player B body identity, armor, palette, and cardinal gameplay reference

generation_model: built-in image generation tool using a single approved project reference

runtime_evidence.alpha_report: not applicable; review sheet uses an opaque studio background
